vv5:1.1: Kuñjaro te varāroho nānāratanakappano ruciro thāmavā javasampanno ākāsamhi samīhati. || ||
vv5:2.1: Padumī padmapattakkhī padm' uppalajutindharo padmacuṇṇābhikiṇṇaṅgo soṇṇapokkharamālavā. || ||
vv5:3.1: Padumānusaṭaṃ maggaṃ padmapattavibhūsitaṃ ṭhitaṃ vaggum anugghāti mitaṃ gacchati vāraṇo. || ||
vv5:4.1: Tassa pakkamamānassa soṇṇakaṃsā ratissarā tesaṃ suyyati nigghoso turiye pañcaṅgike yatha. || ||
vv5:5.1: Tassa nāgassa khandhasmiṃ sucivatthā alaṅkatā mahantaṃ accharāsaṅghaṃ vaṇṇena atirocasi. || ||
vv5:6.1: Dānassa te idaṃ phalaṃ atho sīlassa vā pana atho añjalikammassa taṃ me akkhāhi pucchitā ti. || ||
vv5:7.1: Sā devatā attamanā Moggallānena pucchitā pañhaṃ puṭṭhā viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ: || ||
vv5:8.1: Disvāna guṇasampannaṃ jhāyiṃ jhānarataṃ sataṃ adāsiṃ pupphābhikiṇṇaṃ āsanaṃ dussasanthataṃ. || ||
vv5:9.1: Upaḍḍhaṃ padmamālāhaṃ āsanassa samantato abbhokirissaṃ pattehi pasannā sehi pāṇihi. || ||
vv5:10.1: Tassa kammassa kusalassa idaṃ me īdisaṃ phalaṃ sakkāro garukāro ca devānaṃ apacitā ahaṃ. || ||
vv5:11.1: Yo ve sammāvimuttānaṃ santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ pasanno āsanaṃ dajjā evaṃ nande yathā ahaṃ. || ||
vv5:12.1: Tasmā hi attakāmena mahattam abhikaṅkhatā āsanaṃ dātabbaṃ hoti sarīrantimadhārinan ti. || ||
